video_title: Spurs' Julian Champagnie talks new contract, new house and funniest teammate in 1-on-1

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on his journey from undrafted to NBA contract
quotes.excerpt: not having any guarantees, having to figure it out for myself, it feels pretty good to be here today.
quotes.quote: Being a kid and I think I got to the NBA I was 22 maybe or 21. 22. Just not knowing what was going to happen, not having any guarantees, having to figure it out for myself, it feels pretty good to be here today.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on the Spurs' belief in his potential
quotes.excerpt: They gave me an opportunity when nobody did, you know, so I'm forever in their debt.
quotes.quote: They gave me an opportunity when nobody did, you know, so I'm forever in their debt.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on buying a house in San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it was time to step into something a little more, maybe mature you would say.
quotes.quote: I feel like it was time to step into something a little more, maybe mature you would say, so I went and got me a little house.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on the Spurs' growth as a playoff contender
quotes.excerpt: we went a lot farther than I would say a lot of people thought we would go.
quotes.quote: Coming back from last year, we went a lot farther than I would say a lot of people thought we would go, from a no playoff team to a finals contender.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on using last season's loss as motivation
quotes.excerpt: I think that's going to be the pusher for us, that's going to be what we lean back on.
quotes.quote: I think that's going to be the pusher for us, that's going to be what we lean back on when things get rough during the season and it's game 52 in January or whatever and everybody's tired. We're going to lean back on those memories and those times and kind of understand what we've been through and where we want to get to.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on his confidence in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: having that extra confidence in myself, knowing that I can go out there and perform on the biggest stage.
quotes.quote: I feel like I belong. I think that's kind of the biggest thing I took for me is just having that extra confidence in myself, knowing that I can go out there and perform on the biggest stage, and also learning what I could be better at.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on working with coach Gregg Popovich
quotes.excerpt: great offensive minded coach, gets things done, so I'm excited to work with him.
quotes.quote: I've heard nothing but great things about him. Great offensive minded coach, gets things done, so I'm excited to work with him. I'm excited to work with him. He's a great coach, Hall of Fame, so you know.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on Victor Wembanyama's commitment to the team
quotes.excerpt: He's the biggest team player, best player on one of the best teams.
quotes.quote: He's the biggest team player, best player on one of the best teams, and he's the biggest team player. So I feel like him doing that is kind of a thing where we're all looking at it and saying this is a team, he wants us all to be here, we all want to be here, and that doesn't happen without sacrifice. So shout out to Vic.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie on the most serious and funny teammates
quotes.excerpt: I say maybe Jordan. I think Dill is funny, Keldon's pretty funny.
quotes.quote: I say maybe Jordan. I think Dill is funny, Keldon's pretty funny. I think Vic is a sleeper too, he's pretty funny as well.

quotes.speaker: Julian Champagnie
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Champagnie's message to Spurs fans for the season
quotes.excerpt: we need you guys there, we don't go nowhere without you guys.
quotes.quote: My message to the fans would just be, get ready for a good season. We need you guys there, we don't go nowhere without you guys. The same way we're going to bring it, we need y'all to bring it.
